C0811.title: GitHub Hit by Severe Supply Chain Poisoning Attack
C0811.summary: In March 2024, attackers compromised the GitHub account of Discord Top.gg and tampered with its Python SDK repository by adding a malicious dependency on a package named 'colorama' in requirements.txt.
